title: Battle of Marquain
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Marquain", at revision 1370449122, opens: "The Battle of Marquain was a conflict between Austria and the Kingdom of France during the War of the First Coalition. It took place on 29 April 1792 and ended in a French defeat." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3045026, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1792 it was a conflict between Austria and the Kingdom of France during the War of the First Coalition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
